summary: HR manager with roughly two decades of progressive human resources and administration experience, most recently leading HR as HR Manager and General Manager and HR Director in manufacturing settings including tooling, plastic injection, PVB film, and steel fabrication. Works across the full HR spectrum, including recruitment and selection, compensation and benefits, payroll administration, performance appraisal and management systems, training and development, employee relations, and labor law compliance. Has reported directly to CEOs, transformed HR into a strategic business partner, and oversaw purchasing and general administration alongside HR. Holds a master's degree in public administration and has ongoing training in HR certification, labor law, ISO quality standards, and balanced scorecard KPIs.
